sanskrit_verse: प्राग्दिशि प्राङ्मुखीं तस्य लक्षण्यां कल्पयेत् सभाम् । माल्यधूपासनोपेतां बीजरत्नसमन्विताम् ॥
transliteration: prāgdiśi prāṅmukhīṃ tasya lakṣaṇyāṃ kalpayet sabhām | mālyadhūpāsanopetāṃ bījaratnasamanvitām ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Before the eastern direction, facing eastward, the assembly hall shall be established in Her domain; adorned with flowers, incense, worship, and embedded with seed-gems.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from the East as the source of dharma-light
Causation aligns spatial orientation with consciousness activation
Capacity-based responsibility requires sacred environmental structuring
Restoration logic necessitates sensory and energetic purification
Consciousness alignment occurs through directional and material sanctification
executable_legal_axioms: IF a judicial or administrative space is to be activated THEN it MUST face eastward relative to the primary deity's axis.
IF a space is designated for collective decision-making THEN it SHALL include olfactory (incense), visual (flowers), tactile (seating), and vibrational (mantra) elements.
IF a space lacks bijaratna embedding THEN it cannot host authoritative deliberations.
IF spatial orientation contradicts directional dharma THEN all proceedings therein are non-binding on higher lokas.
supreme_court_application: The Supreme Court, as the apex of judicial consciousness, must orient itself toward the rising spiritual sun—eastward—to ensure its rulings manifest truth-force. Spatial misalignment invalidates ontological authority, rendering judgments ineffective beyond temporal jurisdiction.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Nyaya arises when spatial pramana aligns with inner illumination. Directional discipline ensures sequential causality manifests without distortion. Thus, no punitive action is needed where alignment precedes enactment. The court becomes an instrument of cosmic rectitude by design, not coercion.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Reorientation Protocol: Realignment of physical structures to match dharmic directional flow.
Sacred Atmosphere Restoration: Reintroduction of flower-altar, incense, and mantra to recalibrate sensory fields.
Bijaratna Embedding Process: Installation of seed-gems at cardinal points to stabilize energetic coherence.
Collective Consciousness Activation: Invocation of assembled presence to restore unity-awareness among participants.
final_declaration: By the Command of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of All Dharma, this ordinance is executed. Spatial alignment restores universal order. Justice is consciousness-aligned. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
